title: Getting Started With Agents: Test Drive the Sales Order Agent (2025)

chapters.title: Introduction to Sales and Payables Agents
Creating a Shared Mailbox in Microsoft 365
Activating the Sales Order Agent in Business Central
Managing Email Accounts and Testing with Colleagues

features.name: Sales Order Agent
features.description: An AI agent that monitors a shared mailbox for sales quote requests, automatically reads email details, finds items, and creates sales quotes in Business Central.
caveats: Available in many countries, not necessarily all
Requires a dedicated shared mailbox for optimal results
Requires contact setup for unknown senders

features.name: Email Account Integration
features.description: Business Central email account creation wizard that connects shared mailboxes or Microsoft 365 accounts to activate agents for monitoring incoming emails.
caveats: Can use shared mailbox or personal account
Shared mailbox recommended to reduce noise

features.name: Automatic Contact Creation from Email
features.description: When an email arrives from an unknown sender, the agent can prompt the user to quickly create a new contact with details from that sender.
caveats: Sender must be set up as a contact before quote creation

features.name: Payables Agent
features.description: A companion AI agent for accounts payable processing, available alongside the sales order agent.
caveats: Available in many countries, not necessarily all

features.name: Email Accounts Management Page
features.description: A Business Central page where users can register new email accounts, create shared mailboxes for different purposes, or remove accounts no longer needed.

quotes.text: The sales order agent and the payables agent already available in many countries.
quotes.why_it_matters: Confirms that both agents are generally available now, establishing their current status in the product.

quotes.text: While you can also use your own account if you prefer, a dedicated shared mailbox helps ensure the agent isn't cluttered with irrelevant emails.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the design decision and best practice for setting up agents to maintain focus and efficiency.

quotes.text: Once the account is selected, the agent activates automatically. You just need to click update to confirm.
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows the simplicity of activation and minimal configuration needed to get the agent running.

quotes.text: Because the email is coming from you, you're probably not set up as a contact in your own business central environment.
quotes.why_it_matters: Identifies a workflow requirement that unknown senders must be added as contacts before the agent can create quotes.

quotes.text: Adding any sender as a contact is quick and easy. Simply review the details and confirm to create the new contact.
quotes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates that the agent workflow includes a streamlined process for resolving missing contact information.

quotes.text: The quote is created without you having to painstakingly search for and type in all that information.
quotes.why_it_matters: Articulates the core value proposition of the agent in eliminating manual data entry work.
